refusedInsideAUrl.why: WWG1WGA inside a URL. Certifying a span there puts a fill inside a link and splits the anchor — the same rule that holds ROTHS inside +FLYROTHSFLY+ and the third Q on #2347 inside the handle "Q_ANONBaby". A word inside an address is not a word Q wrote.
